name: MiniCPM Study - CUDA 12.5
onstart:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Paste this entire file into Vast's On-start Script field (SSH launch mode).
set -euo pipefail
prefix="${SPEECH_INSTALL_PREFIX:-/workspace/minicpm-study-install}"
mkdir -p "$prefix/logs"
# Detach provisioning so a long native build does not hold up the SSH startup hook.
nohup bash >> "$prefix/logs/vast-startup.log" 2>&1 <<'BOOT' &
set -euo pipefail
prefix="${SPEECH_INSTALL_PREFIX:-/workspace/minicpm-study-install}"
ref="${SPEECH_STUDY_REF:-9cf8e9b62293f1e556d3e446e9fa67c09b8451ff}"
run="$prefix/runtime"
exec 9>"$prefix/logs/vast-startup.lock"
flock -n 9 || { echo 'Another startup is already running.'; exit 0; }
trap 'printf "Startup failed at line %s. See this log before retrying.\n" "$LINENO" >&2' ERR
printf '\nMiniCPM Study startup: %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
if [[ -f "$run/setup-manifest.json" && -x "$run/bin/start_native.sh" && -x "$run/bin/start_runtime.sh" && -x "$run/bin/start_study.sh" ]]; then
    bash "$prefix/minicpm_study/installation/start.sh" "$run"
else
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    if ! command -v curl >/dev/null || [[ ! -f /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]]; then
        apt-get update
        apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates
    fi
    installer="$prefix/install-download.sh"
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smfabrar/minicpm_study/$ref/installation/install.sh" \
        --output "$installer.part"
    mv "$installer.part" "$installer"
    bash "$installer" --prefix "$prefix" --ref "$ref" \
        --cuda-home /usr/local/cuda-12.5 --jobs "${SPEECH_BUILD_JOBS:-2}"
fi
printf 'MiniCPM Study ready. Forward laptop port 8080 to server port 8765.\n'
BOOT
printf 'Startup runs in the background. Log: %s/logs/vast-startup.log\n' "$prefix"
desc: MiniCPM speech/tool studies. CUDA 12.5, automatic first-boot installation, SSH tunnel, 100 GB disk.
readme:
# MiniCPM Study

First boot installs the website, GPU pipeline, native server and models, then starts them. Later boots start the existing installation. First startup includes CUDA compilation and model downloads and can take a while.

Use one RTX 3090, at least 8 allocated vCPUs, 32 GB RAM and 100 GB disk. The installer uses CUDA 12.5 from this image and its own Python environments. No GPU inference validation has yet been completed for this template.

Watch setup over SSH:

    tail -f /workspace/minicpm-study-install/logs/vast-startup.log

Then forward the website from your laptop:

    ssh -N -p SSH_PORT root@SSH_HOST -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8765

Open http://127.0.0.1:8080. Use the current instance's SSH host and port.

Copy runtime/run-settings.json into a study's settings. Operations and updates are documented at https://github.com/smfabrar/minicpm_study/blob/main/installation/README.md.

This template pins application commit 9cf8e9b. That commit must be available in the GitHub repository before first boot. The application and minicpm_tool reference repositories must be readable without interactive login. No credentials are embedded. Container storage is lost when the instance is destroyed; export studies first.
